title: Verity Dash - Smart County Overview
description: The Verity County smart-county dashboard. Twelve live widgets, four of which are live.

weather.summary: Clear. Sensor last reported 4 days ago; value carried forward.

transit.note: Temporary diversion via Halsey Road in effect since 14 February 2024. Adds 19 minutes. The word temporary has not been reviewed.
Diverted around the Mill Street bridge since August 2023. The bridge reopened in May 2025. The diversion did not.
Diversion of indeterminate origin. No work order on file. Operators report the diversion is in the schedule software and cannot be removed by anyone at the depot.
Running to schedule. Every 15 minutes weekdays, 20 minutes weekends.
Two round trips daily, Tuesday and Thursday only. Ridership last quarter: 31.
Hourly. The only rail service remaining in the county.

Branch closed 2004. Retained in this feed because removing it requires a change request to a vendor that no longer exists. Enthusiast documentation at [url=synth://forums.verityrail.org/]forums.verityrail.org[/url].

energy.trend: up 3.1% this week (estimated; meter data feed last ingested 2025-11-30)

alerts.text: County offices closed Thursday and Friday. Details at [url=synth://verity.county.gov/]verity.county.gov[/url].
Air quality sensor GF-02 (Gridfall north) has reported a constant value of 41 since March. Readings from this sensor should not be used.
Route 62 corridor: intermittent radio interference reported. The County advises that this is expected and requests no further reports.
Boil-water advisory for Milbrook lifted. Advisory was issued 2021-07-08 and lifted 2021-07-11. This alert has been displayed continuously since 2021-07-11.
TEST ALERT - DO NOT ACT - This is a test of the county alert channel. Test scheduled 2024-09-03 02:00. Test has not been cleared.

widgets.title: Grid Load - Gridfall Substation
lines: The Gridfall substation was decommissioned after the 2003 fire and carries no load. This widget reports zero as nominal and has done since it was installed in 2022.

widgets.title: County Population
lines: This figure is a county-wide projection displayed under a Gridfall-only heading. Both numbers are wrong in opposite directions and the error has been logged as [i]working as designed[/i].

widgets.title: Open Service Requests
lines: Median age of open request: 511 days
Oldest open request: [b]2,509 days[/b] - 'Site status inquiry, substation parcel'

widgets.title: Air Quality
lines: Gridfall north (GF-02): [b]41[/b] - flagged, constant since March
County index shown elsewhere on this page averages all four, including the flagged and the missing.

widgets.title: Parking Availability - Gridfall Union
lines: The sensor counts vehicles entering and leaving and has drifted upward by roughly two spaces per month since 2023. It is recalibrated annually in January.

widgets.title: River Level - Kestrel Creek at Halsey
lines: Gauge reading is current and correct. This widget works.

widgets.title: County Newsfeed
lines: Items from a named local byline: [b]6[/b]
Everything else in this feed is a rewrite of those six.

widgets.title: Transit Ridership
lines: Note: figure includes Route 11 boardings, which are modelled rather than counted because the Route 11 fareboxes were removed in 2024.

widgets.title: Emergency Services - Average Response
lines: Figures cover the Gridfall district only. The unincorporated county is not measured and is not represented in any number shown on this dashboard.

widgets.title: Well Water Testing
lines: Out-of-range results are followed up by a county sanitarian by telephone, same day.
This programme works and is almost entirely unused. Request a kit: [url=synth://verity.county.gov/]verity.county.gov[/url]

widgets.title: Ask The County
lines: The County does not review, endorse, or correct answers produced by the assistant, and notes that residents have reported it giving the wrong year for the substation fire, the wrong status for the Ashkettle branch, and opening hours for a diner that closed in 2006.
